title: Optimization Strategy Schema
description: Canonical optimization strategy selection and capability mapping for public algorithm names.

auto.description: Cloud-first automatic strategy selection with local fallback. execution_mode is capability metadata; the public request selectors are algorithm/offline (and hybrid_api_options for an external evaluator).

bayesian.description: Smart Bayesian-style search using TPE (cloud mode).

hyperband.description: Planned early-pruning search; not currently executable in cloud mode.

frontier_scout.description: Planned Pareto-frontier exploration; not currently available as a selectable algorithm.

AdvertisedOptimizationAlgorithmName.description: All algorithm names that may appear in public capability metadata.

SupportedOptimizationStrategyName.description: Algorithm names accepted for new optimization_strategy requests.

OptimizationImplementationStatus.description: 'supported' = currently executable; 'planned' = advertised in the vocabulary but not yet available.

OptimizationCapabilityExecutionMode.description: Canonical execution-mode capability metadata for an algorithm (Traigent#2271: legacy execution_mode request selector and its edge_analytics/hybrid/hybrid_api values are removed). 'local' = client-side orchestration (grid, random algorithms) with no backend egress. 'cloud' = backend-driven trial suggestion (auto, bayesian/tpe, hyperband, frontier_scout). An external evaluator is a separate, orthogonal concern selected via hybrid_api_options, not an execution_mode value.

execution_mode.description: Canonical execution-mode metadata for the algorithm capability (local or cloud).

description.x-content-note: INV-GAP S1,S3,S5,O2,H1: not inventoried (free string): description

OptimizationStrategyConfig.description: Optimization strategy requested by SDK direct tuning clients.

oneOf.x-content-note: INV-GAP (implicit-open, reclassified by review): object accepts properties it does not declare (additionalProperties omitted or true); extra names and values are unclassified

algorithm.description: Public SDK optimization algorithm selector. auto lets Traigent choose cloud-first automatic execution with local fallback.

offline.description: force fully-local execution with no backend egress.

hybrid_api_options.description: Optional external evaluator configuration. Meaningful only when an external evaluator is configured.
